question: Does prefix-only three-handle activation recover a reusable 10K quality gain while retaining H72 token savings?

hypotheses.mechanism: The full three-handle set identifies prefixes where compact evidence substitution is useful; lower-count prefixes retain the control review.
hypotheses.prediction: A three-handle prefix-only gate gains at least 0.05 macro Span-F1 with non-degrading secondary metrics and non-increasing aggregate tokens.
hypotheses.falsifier: A causally valid frozen conditional cohort misses any semantic or aggregate-token gate.
hypotheses.scope: GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench transfer from confirmed 8K to 10K; conditional development only.

hypotheses.mechanism: Ten thousand native tokens retain enough evidence that compact terminal handles add little value.
hypotheses.prediction: The larger native window dilutes the quality benefit even after handle-count conditioning.
hypotheses.falsifier: The conditional policy passes every frozen development gate.
hypotheses.scope: GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench transfer from confirmed 8K to 10K; conditional development only.

hypotheses.mechanism: Evidence usefulness depends on displacement or task structure not captured by the number of available handles.
hypotheses.prediction: Handle count is only a proxy; another prefix-observable displacement signal is required.
hypotheses.falsifier: The three-handle conditional policy passes and later confirms.
hypotheses.scope: GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench transfer from confirmed 8K to 10K; conditional development only.

hypotheses.mechanism: The confirmed 8K mechanism does not transfer usefully to 10K.
hypotheses.prediction: No qualifying conditional quality gain exists within the token constraint.
hypotheses.falsifier: The conditional policy passes development and fresh confirmation.
hypotheses.scope: GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench transfer from confirmed 8K to 10K; conditional development only.
